market.conclusion: This is a broad, tech-led sell-off. Only 12% of stocks are above their 50-day average, QQQ is in a downtrend, and fear is elevated. Lending markets show no stress, so this looks like a stock-market and AI shakeout, not a credit crisis. That makes it a time to collect quality businesses slowly, not a time for short-term entries.
arguments: Macro (against on every name): tech is in a downtrend with the VIX at 28.44. I weigh this heavily for the next few weeks, because a weak market drags down even good stocks.

Technical: most names show lower highs and lower lows. I give this the most weight for swing calls. Oversold readings (SPY RSI 24.9, NVDA RSI 15.0) can bring a bounce, but they are not a reason to enter.
Fundamental: several quality businesses (NVDA, NFLX, ORCL) now sit at or below fair value. I weigh this heavily for the long term only.
Quant: no validated evidence, and 0 of 627 forecasts have been scored. I give it no weight.
Risk: no vetoes. The only near-term earnings flag is AVGO on 2026-12-09, which rules out Enter there.
Credit and rates: credit spreads are steady and the 10-year is little changed over 4 weeks. This is a mild positive and argues against panic.
market.change_mind: A daily close for SPY above $698.74 and for QQQ above $626.27, fear easing back below 20 on the VIX, and the 2026-11-25 GDP and PCE inflation releases not adding new pressure.

deep_dive.case_for: Grade A business with revenue up 83.38% over 12 months and a forward P/E of 8.79. At $125.53 it sits below its whole value range ($190.68–$411.04), and its price-to-sales is near the bottom of its own 5-year history. Next-year earnings estimates rose 4.34% in 30 days (Yahoo, unverified).
deep_dive.case_against: It is down 40.5% in 20 days and 14.01% in one day, with no chart support level identified. The operating margin of 65% is at the top of its 5-year range, and peaks like that usually fade. Unpaid customer bills are up 127% against sales up 106%, insiders sold $946.6M outside pre-set plans, and headlines point to a leadership change after Jensen Huang's exit. It is also the biggest name in a tech downtrend.
deep_dive.decides: For the long term, whether the 65% margin holds, which the data cannot show yet. For the swing, a close above $150.14. Until then the long-term position should be built in small steps.
